selection_rule: Among the hybrid variants, the highest development MRR (comma level) wins; variants within 0.01 of it are separated by development recall@5, and those within 0.01 of the best recall@5 by the fewest parameters changed from the baseline, then by name.
adoption_rule: The chosen variant becomes the default only if, on the test set, its MRR is higher than the baseline's and its recall@5 is not lower.
